title: Law to create city office for free child care
summary: This bill would require the mayor to set up an Office of Child Care and Early Childhood Education within one year to plan and run free child care for all New York City children, including undocumented children, by 2030. The office would coordinate agencies, identify child care locations, set wages and funding standards for providers, and report annually to the mayor and City Council. It would take effect September 1, 2026.
